title: skills: objectstack-ui actions rule teaches the api.write grant as prose; the trap is now refused at validate and publish (after #37807)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of a delivery in review. PR #37807 (card #35143, Seeds and actions family) adds the error `action-body-write-capability-undeclared`: an action body that calls a `ctx.api` write without `api.write` in its `body.capabilities` is refused by `os validate` / `os lint` / `os build` and at publish. Card #35143's Scope says: "When a family lands, the matching trap leaves the published skills where it is taught as prose."

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:15-16` teaches the grant as prose ("without it the sandbox throws on a write"). Once #37807 merges, rewrite it to point at the rule (the check now catches it; name the rule id and its fix) instead of teaching the trap.
- Also check the same skill for the seed-key and object-binding traps (`seed-record-unknown-field`, `object-reference-unknown` at seeds, flow CRUD/screen nodes and actions).

Prerequisite: PR #37807 merged. `skills/**` may be a governed path; the PR follows whatever review that path needs.
Suggested-grade: p3 · prose follow-up of a landed check.
Dedupe: `api.write actions.md`, `write capability skill` found only #35143 and PR #37807. Precedent: #37529 (the Data model family's skills follow-up).
